capex: So, now we have 20 acres surplus of land for our future expansion at Mahad, plus we have about 10, 12 acres in Khopoli for our expansion program, which is lined up.
So, about INR250 crores to INR300 crores rupees of expansion will be going on in our existing products.

I would also like to thank our partners, vendors, customers, and investors who have placed their trust in us and stood by us in good and in challenging times as well.
focus: We also then decided to diversify and have one more location rather than putting all eggs in Khopoli itself.
We have been blessed by Warren Buffett, I must say, that diversification is humility applied to uncertainty.
And in today's time, you would have seen many multinationals also looking at more and more diversification for stability.
